name: Planning and Information Requests
description: Restaurant and selected-ingredient scope, requested planning/information task, period and relevant demand context. Requests enable the requested interaction; they do not approve purchases.

name: Purchase Quantity Revisions
description: Manager edits associated with a restaurant, draft/order version, ingredient, quantity and unit. Accepted changes update the unapproved draft without implying approval.

name: Explicit Purchase Approvals
description: Explicit authorization associated with the final manager-approved order version and quantities. This is a control on commitment/transmission, separate from the revision input.

name: Restaurant Operational Records
description: Bundled restaurant records covering inventory/batches, actual receipts, historical usage, counts/corrections, waste events, diner-cover observations and proposed ingredient-demand/stockout observations. Preserve quantities, units, occurrence/update context and explicit unknown information. Proposed evaluation dictionary: each demand opportunity identifies restaurant, ingredient, period, opportunity ID, occurrence time, observed availability outcome and observation completeness. Stockout rate uses unavailable observed demand opportunities divided by all valid observed opportunities for the same declared scope and period. Zero stock alone does not establish a demand stockout. Missing observations or zero denominators yield not calculable. This dictionary is a proposed evaluation clarification, not a confirmed operational policy.

name: Supplier Confirmation Delivery and Exception Information
description: Transaction-associated supplier responses covering confirmation, delivery information, partial/delayed events and exceptions. If no valid associated supplier response has been received, the order remains unconfirmed. Messages are distinct from physical fulfillment.

name: Recovery Response and Exception Information
description: Request-associated collection/pickup responses, exception context and reported follow-up. Source: UC.11, UC.12, UC.15 and the recovery loop in the operational concept; stakeholder coverage must be reviewed without inventing partner commitments.

name: Service Policies and Authorized Support Commands
description: Agreed operating hours, role/restaurant permissions, planning/retention rules and authorized support/recovery/handover commands. Unconfirmed values stay proposed; demo defaults do not become operational policy.

name: Inventory and Expiration Information
description: Restaurant-specific recorded ingredient/batch quantity, unit, update time, known/unknown expiration and horizon-based alerts. This reports recorded information rather than physical freshness certification.

name: Reviewable Purchasing Recommendations
description: Proposed purchase quantities with expected demand, usable recorded stock, expiration horizon and material data limitations. Recommendations are drafts until explicit final approval.

name: Joint Waste and Availability Measures
description: Waste mass per 100 diner covers and ingredient stockout rate for the same restaurant, ingredient scope and evaluation period, with missing/zero denominator treatment stated.

name: Approved Purchase Orders
description: Final orders associated with explicit manager approval. Ingredient identifiers, quantities and units remain unchanged between the approved version and outgoing supplier payload.

name: Waste Collection Requests
description: Restaurant/request identifier, recorded surplus or recovery context and requested coordination information, as supported by the prior operational concept. A request is not evidence of completed collection.

name: Recorded Order and Collection Status
description: The current recorded transaction state, confirmation or exception, associated follow-up and available delivery/pickup information. Pending, partial, delayed and resolved states remain distinguishable.

name: Operational Record Acknowledgments
description: Accepted/rejected entry results and retained record identifiers or correction references. An acknowledgment certifies processing of a record, not the truth of a physical measurement.

name: Exception and Service Monitoring Information
description: Affected order/collection transaction, restaurant, responsible party, current exception state and follow-up/resolution, together with workflow-availability observations for authorized service support.

name: Recovered and Handover Records
description: Two related lifecycle outcomes distinguished in detailed requirements: restored confirmed records, and authorized handover exports. Both preserve required identifiers, quantities, units and recorded decision/correction relationships.

name: Authorized PANTRI Interaction State
description: Availability and authorized restaurant/task access conditions governing each participant interaction with PANTRI. This control gates use of the information service; it does not control external physical business operations. It derives from service/access policy and must not claim that authenticated access exists in the current offline prototype.
